 Print Odisha schools closed in six districts till November 21 due to Cyclonic Storm Akvan Schools in seven districts of Odisha will remain closed on November 19 and 20 in view of Cyclonic Storm Akvan. The School and Mass Education Department, Odisha, has announced the closure of all government, aided and private schools as a precautionary measure to ensure the safety of students. According to the department's announcement, schools in six districts will also remain closed on November 21. These districts are Ganjam, Gajapati, Puri, Jagatsinghpur, Kendrapada and Kandhamal. In Khordha district, all government, aided and private schools will remain closed on November 19 and 20. Join conversation

 Odisha school holiday: District-wise closure dates
 The department shared the school closure announcement through its official X handle, @SMEOdisha, on November 18. As per the notice, the holiday schedule is as follows: District School closure dates 
 Ganjam November 19, 20 and 21 
 Gajapati November 19, 20 and 21 
 Puri November 19, 20 and 21 
 Jagatsinghpur November 19, 20 and 21 
 Kendrapada November 19, 20 and 21 
 Kandhamal November 19, 20 and 21 
 Khordha November 19 and 20 
 The closure applies to all government, aided and private schools in the districts mentioned in the announcement. The decision was taken as a precautionary measure in view of Cyclonic Storm Akvan. The closure is aimed at ensuring the safety of students amid the weather conditions. Schools in the six districts will reopen after the three-day closure, while schools in Khordha will remain closed for two days. The department has not announced any further changes to the school schedule.
